answer: Contribution-Gated Reputation Carryover. Each identity’s reputation accrues only from work validated by distinct counterparties, and a velvet ceiling caps transferable history per identity. Cloning forces an attacker to run a fresh slow spiral of genuine transactions before any clone earns matching weight, so each new identity costs weeks of real labor plus fees. Ravens flag clusters sharing counterparties, freezing gains, making one honest identity cheaper than many clones.
